title: Grilled Chicken Zingeroni
description: A flavorful grilled chicken dish marinated in zingeroni sauce, served with a side of Japanese-inspired grilled vegetables.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together zingeroni sauce and rice vinegar.
Add the mixture to the chicken breast and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and grill for 5-6 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, brush the vegetables with olive oil and grill for 3-4 minutes per side.
Slice the grilled chicken and serve with the vegetables.
Serve with additional zingeroni sauce on the side, if desired.
